name: Data Science
description: Designed for students majoring in disciplines other than Statistics and Data Science to acquire knowledge for mature use of data analysis. Students gain skills to tackle real-world data analysis challenges in the humanities, social sciences, sciences, and engineering.
notes: Minimum grade B– in each certificate course
No course may satisfy both a major and the certificate
No single course may count toward two certificate areas
Declare intent by the last day of add/drop in the final term of enrollment on Yale Hub
Students are held to the Statistical Methodology and Data Analysis requirements in place when they declared; with DUS approval, updated 2024–2025 requirements may be fulfilled by prior declarers

requirements.name: Prerequisite
requirements.description: Suggested introductory course. An introductory data analysis course from another department may also satisfy this prerequisite.

requirements.name: Probability and Statistical Theory
requirements.description: Advanced students may substitute S&DS 3510, S&DS 3640, or ECE 4310.

requirements.name: Statistical Methodology and Data Analysis
requirements.description: S&DS 2200 and S&DS 2300 may not both count. ECON 2136 may be substituted for S&DS 2420.

requirements.name: Computation and Machine Learning
requirements.description: CPSC 3230 may be substituted for CPSC 2230.

requirements.name: Data Analysis in a Discipline Area
requirements.description: One course approved for this requirement and listed on the S&DS website.
